pages.text: This enchantment is entirely unique. The effect it has depends on the pearl that the jewelry is made from. Listed below are the effects:
pages.title: Elemental Affinity (MAX 1)

pages.text: $(li)Black ~ Bonus attack damage at night$(li)Blue ~ Immune to drowning damage$(li)Brown ~ Digging dirt provides Bait$(li)Gold ~ Killing entities drop gold nuggets$(li)Green ~ Immunity to poison$(li)Orange ~ Bonus xp on kills$(li)Pink ~ Killing entities restores health
$(li)Purple ~ Immune to magic damage$(li)Red ~ Immune to fire and lava$(li)Silver ~ Silverfish sometimes drop a cooked cod$(li)White ~ Bonus attack damage at day$(li)Yellow ~ Immune to earthly damage
